mekki-muskil:5-5.t: His saying, the Exalted: (فجعله غثاء أحوى): the hāʾ and (غثاء) are two objects of (جعل), because it means "made into" (صيّر). (أحوى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (الغثاء), meaning "black". It is also said that (أحوى) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (المرعى), (أحوى) meaning "green", i.e. He brought out its greenness and then made it stubble. (الغثاء) is dry, broken plant matter, like the scum of a flood.

mekki-muskil:6-7.t:
His saying (فلا تنسى): (لا) has the meaning of (ليس); it is a statement, not a prohibition, since it is not permissible for a person to be forbidden from forgetting, because it is not by his choice.
His saying (إلا ما شاء الله): (ما) is in the position of the accusative as an exception, i.e. "you will not forget except what Allah wills to lift its recitation and abrogate it without replacement". It is also said that (تنسى) means "you leave", so the meaning is "except what Allah wills to command you to leave, so you leave it". It is also said that its meaning is "except what Allah wills, and Allah does not will that you forget any of it"; so it is like His saying in Hūd, in the two places: (خالدين فيها ما دامت السموات والأرض إلا ما شاء ربك); it is said that its meaning is "except what your Lord wills, and He, exalted be His mention, does not will to leave off any of the eternity", since His will for them of eternity has preceded. There are many views on it other than this, which we have set out separately and explained in a separate book. It is also said that (إلا ما شاء الله) is an exception from (فجعله غثاء أحوى).
